title: An Empirical Study of Collective Behaviors and Social Dynamics in Large Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying LLM-generated posts as liberal, conservative, or moderate using a multi-persona stance detection pipeline, and computing user-level ideology scores to evaluate network homophily, group clustering, and ideological polarization.

Using stance detection to assign positive, negative, or neutral scores to posts discussing humans, and computing an average leaning score for each LLM agent to analyze polarized attitudes and toxic language directed at humanity.
